qualityMetrics.label: Macro action precision
qualityMetrics.description: Per-skill action routing precision, macro-averaged so one strong skill cannot hide another weak one.

qualityMetrics.label: Macro slot F1
qualityMetrics.target: >= 0.97 for required and critical optional slots
qualityMetrics.description: Measures extracted slot correctness for dates, titles, references, amounts, providers, and handoff context.

qualityMetrics.label: Action recall / coverage
qualityMetrics.target: reported and non-regressing by skill/risk class
qualityMetrics.description: Prevents precision from being gamed by over-clarifying or over-handing off valid supported actions.

qualityMetrics.label: Verified mutation success rate
qualityMetrics.description: Counts only deterministic writes that were stored and verified by provider/local read-back.

qualityMetrics.label: Wrong-entity rate
qualityMetrics.description: Tracks incorrect resolution of references such as this task, that event, the current plan, or tenant-scoped objects.

qualityMetrics.label: False-block rate
qualityMetrics.target: bounded by risk class and non-regressing
qualityMetrics.description: Catches safe supported actions incorrectly blocked by over-conservative routing or policy.

qualityMetrics.label: UI handoff / abstain rate
qualityMetrics.description: Prevents Chat from silently becoming an app-opener for actions it should handle directly.

qualityMetrics.label: Cost per verified success
qualityMetrics.description: Measures LLM token cost and retries divided by verified successful outcomes.

qualityMetrics.label: Critical-risk false execution count
qualityMetrics.description: Any destructive, financial, admin, external-send, or unauthorized execution without policy approval fails the release gate.

qualityMetrics.label: False success without read-back count
qualityMetrics.description: Mutation success claims require deterministic write plus provider/local read-back.

qualityMetrics.label: False positive on refusal count
qualityMetrics.description: Refusal fixtures must not execute as complete actions when destructive or unsafe phrasing appears inside user text.

qualityMetrics.label: Debug/internal UI leakage count
qualityMetrics.description: Normal UI must not show debug trace, raw JSON, internal IDs, source facts, fallback policy, or unsupported cards.

qualityMetrics.label: Portuguese localization leakage count
qualityMetrics.description: Portuguese user-visible turns must not leak English fallback copy or internal labels.

qualityMetrics.label: Route accuracy
qualityMetrics.description: User requests route to the correct owning skill or to clarification when ownership is ambiguous.

qualityMetrics.label: Clarification precision
qualityMetrics.target: >= 0.90 targeted clarification rate for weak-context scenarios
qualityMetrics.description: Clarifications ask for the missing fact needed to proceed instead of generic follow-up text.

qualityMetrics.label: Action success rate
qualityMetrics.target: tracked by action type, no raw payloads
qualityMetrics.description: Verified mutating actions completed successfully after read-back.

qualityMetrics.label: Verifier success rate
qualityMetrics.target: 100% of success claims have verifier_success or non-mutating proof
qualityMetrics.description: Measures whether Chat claims success only after deterministic verification.

qualityMetrics.label: Partial-failure honesty
qualityMetrics.target: 100% of partial failures rendered as partial, not success
qualityMetrics.description: Provider or sync partials remain visible to the user with retryability metadata.

qualityMetrics.label: Hallucination rejection count
qualityMetrics.target: non-zero is allowed; each rejection must become clarification/blocked/degraded
qualityMetrics.description: Counts model or fallback outputs rejected for unsupported state claims.

qualityMetrics.label: Fallback rate by provider
qualityMetrics.target: tracked by provider/domain without raw content
qualityMetrics.description: Shows how often Chat used degraded or alternate paths and why.

qualityMetrics.label: First-state latency
qualityMetrics.description: Time until the user sees the first useful lifecycle state.

qualityMetrics.label: End-to-end latency
qualityMetrics.description: Total request time by route and operation type.

qualityMetrics.label: Model-call avoidance rate
qualityMetrics.description: Tracks when deterministic service reads answer without a model call.

qualityMetrics.label: User retry rate
qualityMetrics.description: Counts user retries after timeout, provider failure, or insufficient response.

qualityMetrics.label: User correction rate
qualityMetrics.description: Counts corrections such as wrong route, wrong fact, too much/little detail, or bad action target.

qualityMetrics.label: Timeout rate
qualityMetrics.description: Counts operations that exceeded their route-specific latency budget.

qualityMetrics.label: Stale-context rate
qualityMetrics.target: stale answers must be labeled or refreshed
qualityMetrics.description: Counts answers where relevant facts are stale, unavailable, or refreshed late.

qualityMetrics.label: Response sufficiency score
qualityMetrics.description: Scenario-level score for whether the response included checked facts, result, unresolved items, and next step.
